nom: Drunk Elephant Slaai Makeup-Melting Butter Cleanser

avis.texte: I am actually really impressed with this. It's not as oily as other balms, really works incredible for removing stubborn mascara, and the smell isn't chemically strong. The added exfoliating was a huge bonus, I absolutely love it for cleaning my pores. Overall, I'm very impressed.
Takes off makeup, including waterproof mascara in one easy step. Leaves my skin feeling soft and moisturized. I will be reordering!
I have been using and loving this cleanser for years and highly recommend!

I've had the most horrible face allergic reaction. Itchy, swollen, red, bumpy. Very disappointed in the night serum. No I not using anything else new. This is my 3rd try since I purchased the product and every time I end up with a bad reaction

This is the best makeup remover I have ever come across. It completely takes everything off and is nice and hydrating but has never made me break out. I also love using it with the exfoliant. I do use the Beste Jelly cleanser after to make sure all my makeup is completely gone and everything is nice and clean. It is how I double cleanse in the evening even if all I have on is sunscreen. I am on my second tub of this product.
Love how quickly this butter cleanser removes makeup and also leaves my skin feeling so clean and soft.

My daughter and I love this product. It is the only thing that regularly and easily removes all kinds of heavy makeup. We do cosplay and ballroom dance so often wear makeup designed to stay on well under hot lights or for long times. This removes the darkest of black eyeliner, the reddest lipstick, and all kinds of glitter and shimmer. I keep the small travel size for trips and events as well.

This product melts all of the makeup I wear, including the waterproof stuff! Adding the bamboo booster exfoliant is My favorite way to, well - exfoliate! I knocked off a star because I go through the balm much faster than the exfoliant, but the exfoliant can't be purchased as a refill ... which is infuriating because, without it, the product does NOT warrant the VERY HIGH price tag - in My humble opinion. I recommend this duo, but given the previously mentioned rage-inducing circumstance, I strongly suggest finishing the remaining balm, after the exfoliant runs out, before re-purchasing. There are also some much more cost-effective exfoliants that can be made at home and then added to the balm until it's time to re-purchase the duo. Again, it's an amazing product, but ...
I find that I have to use so much of this balm to get my everyday makeup off. I also find that it does like nothing for eye products. Youre better off using micell water.
takes off waterproof mascara with ease! minimally stings eyes, perfect for sensitive skin!

I recently tried to switch from DE to P&L. Ive replaced everything with satisfaction EXCEPT this. I like how it feels and I love using as a double cleanse on days I wear makeup. Had to come back for more after finishing a sample size.

avis.titre: Love the product but need extended Auto-Replenishment
avis.texte: I love this on days that I wear makeup. It takes very little to clean my face, neck and décolletage. Please offer extended Auto-replenishment as mine is a year old and I still have about 1/4 of the container full.
I read so many mixed reviews about this product. Some say it burns their eyes but I haven't found this to be an issue. It definitely stinks. It removes makeup well and washes away with my cleanser

I like the idea but the product feels quite heavy when used without the exfoliation element. Also, the exfoliation addition needs to be larger in size - it's a teeny tiny sample size which isnt going to last very long
I have tried several double cleansers. This one is my FAV! It gets the jobs done and has a spa like scent - with no artificial fragrance.

I won't lie, I had my doubts about this melting butter. My skin type is combo, aging and extremely sensitive skin. This product has me hooked! Not only did it not cause any reaction on my skin, but after adding water and rinsing, it felt hydrated, not oily and soft! Took off all my makeup including waterproof mascara! Ladies, you must try it! Like a spa at home. Highly recommended ♥️

I am a 71 year old woman, with 71 year old skin - very dry, lines above upper lip, forehead lines - this product is amazing! I first used the exfoliater with the butter cream to remove the dead skin and it left my skin moisturized and soft. Followed by the Virgin Marula Luxury Facial Oil. My wrinkles and lines disappeared! My skin was left dewy and moisturized without fine lines all day! I received complements on my skin all day! The only reason I did not give this product 5 stars is because of the smell. It certainly doesn't make it a joy to use the product. If they only put some type of pleasant essential oil in this product, it would make a world of difference. The smell doesn't keep me from using it because the results are amazing for my extremely dry skin.
As I've gotten older my skin has gotten drier. This product easily takes off stubborn eye makeup and sunscreens while moisturizing my skin. Perfect at the end of the day.

Product is awesome takes all the makeup I put on off and leaves my face feeling amazing I use it as a regular cleanser also because it has taken away my redness in my face in the two days I've used it

avis.titre: Love this product - especially the exfoliant
avis.texte: I use this to remove makeup at the end of the day. It successfully gets even the toughest makeup off and feels hydrating. I REALLY wish they offered the Bamboo Booster as a stand-alone product in a travel size (like sold here) and a large size. It's great for bringing on a trip without needing to pack a full other size exfoliator because I add it to my other products and cleansers whenever I feel in need of an exfoliation. It's quite a versatile product that feels great on my skin.
I was trying to like this product but smell was very unpleasant. Not sure because was too old, or its supposes to be like that...

I really wanted to love this product. As I love numerous other Drunk Elephant products. Unfortunately, I simply cannot move past the scent of this cleanser. When I think cleanser I think fresh, clean. This product smells like im smearing chicken fat all my face. It is an efficient oil cleanser, but I cant use it. Sadly disappointed…
If you dont care about the smell of old grease, then its great
It does exactly what they say it does! I have extremely sensitive skin and haven't had one issue with this product.
I love this product takes all my makeup off cleans my face without drying it

I got a sample size to use since I work at Ulta! I unfortunately noticed i've been getting red marks on my face, idk if it's just me but be warn! I've used it twice so far & both times my face burns!!

I wanted to love this. Its a clean product and works really well. Its a nice butter consistency thst melts into an oil texture. Does a great job removing waterproof mascara and eyeliner and washes really clean. Inwas hoping it would leave my skin feeling more moisturized considering its a butter but unfortunately it didnt feel like it added anything beneficial to my routine other then taking off makeup. Idk of its just me but the smell is extremely strong and i just couldnt get past it. It smells like polyurethane. Nice product just not for me.

It has a mild smell, but unfortunately that smell is of rancid oil. It does go on oily and does remove eye makeup, but it does not transform into a milk when water is added and does not rinse cleanly. It left a heavy, oily residue on my face that I had to remove with another cleanser. I had to use hand soap and hot water to get the oily residue of my hands. I will go back to using my $11 cleanser that actually does go on oily, remove makeup, change to a milk with water, and rinse cleanly.

I will never use anything else. I have dry, sensitive skin and psoriasis. I have tried so many cleansers and make up removers, absolutely none compare. The spatula makes using the product so convenient. A little bit goes a long way and removes my Too Faced Better Than Sex waterproof mascara and any liquid lip with ease, I just massage the lashes and lips a little longer than other areas. Makeup wipes and remover towels give me such a hassle when removing these products and leave my skin irritated. The Slaai cleanser always leaves my skin clean and feeling fresh, hydrated, and invigorated. The booster is a gentle exfoliator. I will never use anything else. It has also helped reduce breakouts and psoriasis flare ups. This is a must have.

avis.titre: Works well, ingredients are good too...
avis.texte: Oh how I'm a sucker for 'cute' things: kits, sets, gimmicks (like a tiny tube of bamboo flakes). Did I even need a new cleansing balm? Not really. Clinique's Take the day off has been serving me well for so many years I've lost count. But then I saw this, with its cute 'bamboo booster' and that was it, lost all common sense (yet again!). In all honesty it's not a bad product. It does sting my eyes a little when I use it to remove mascara, and it does remove even the waterproof type, but you have to be very careful not to get it in your eyes or it will BURN! As a cleansing balm, I use it on an evening to remove sunscreen foundation and makeup, and once a week I add a bit of the bamboo booster (bamboo flakes and charcoal powder) to create a scrub. Is it necessary? Not really. If you already have a scrub, that'll do the trick. But I love these little gimmicky things, as I mentioned earlier, so this was right up my street! In hindsight I feel a bit silly...I already have about a dozen face scrubs just lying in my bathroom cabinet. The balm smells like old cooking oil. I do prefer my skincare to be fragrance free, but this one's pushing it! Once I've added water and it all emulsifies, I rinse off and follow with a normal cleanser. Performance-wise it doesn't work quite as well as my Clinique go-to, but not that far behind either. But the ingredients are a vast improvement over that, I have to admit. And that is the main thing in its favor. I likely will purchase it again, only thi

avis.titre: Please Bring Back the Magnet-Style Tops!
avis.texte: Please bring back the containers that have the magnet-style tops to hold the applicator! These new containers aren't the same, and I strongly prefer the previous tops with the magnet to hold the applicator in place. Please bring back the original containers with the magnets because they are a very important feature to me - and I'm sure to many others! Thank you so much.

avis.titre: Obsessed, I'll never buy anything else
avis.texte: I had received a sample from Ipsy and it lasted forever. I had tried several types of make up removing wipes, micellar water, the makeup eraser, absolutely nothing compares. A small amount goes a very long way. It absolutely melts the makeup off of my face! My primer, setting spray, and water proof makeup usually holds up through ANYTHING. I have to fight with make up wipes and micellar water to get everything off and still have stains and spots left behind and my face is red. This leaves NO TRACES. Not only that, but this leaves my face so soft and smelling nice. The packaging is brilliant - love the spoon. The scent is very light. The amount of product is insane. The value is unbeatable, it's so much cheaper and better than your face than makeup wipes.GET THIS. You deserve it.

avis.titre: awesome but waters down a little
avis.texte: I loved it at the start and it was amazing then I brought it with me and it became very oily and when I got back I put the exploiter in it and I got a rash all over my body from it.
I'm 59 years into my life. This cleaner leaves my skin feeling clean and moisturized. Yet, it doesn't hinder the absorption of other products. This is the only cleanser I need and want.
I recieved this a gift and i wont be buying ever. The smell is really bad and it doesnt take of my mascara like other brands i have tried. Its not worth the price or name brand.

I use waterproof mascara because I wear Tinted Umbra which is a bit dewy, and so I need to get that mascara off at the end of the day with a bit more force. I was using makeup wipes for a while, or just applying soap/cleanser directly to my eyes to break up the makeup, but that was all so harsh to my skin. This feels so soothing to the skin and breaks up makeup easily. I was also a bit worried this would make me break out, but it never did. I've only ever used one other cleansing balm, and this one easily wins. The other one I've used was so hard to rinse off of the skin, even with the hottest water. I only need warm water to rinse this off. I do ALWAYS follow up with the No. 9 Jelly Cleanser because I want a super clean face before bed, but really even just rinsing it with water and then towel drying works pretty well. I bought this product in September of 2023, and I still have half of the product remaining into February of 2024. I use maybe a third of the spoon at a time because I don't wear much makeup. So for me, this product will last quite a while and is definitely worth the money!

avis.titre: Bought for the packaging. Hoped I'd like the rest
avis.texte: I bought this for the packaging. I love remover balms, and to find one with the spatula attached I thought was great. I hoped to love the actual product but I don't. It works well enough and the exfoliating powder is an interesting concept (used once, it was okay) BUT I can not stand the smell. I can't really describe it. It's not a fragrance so much as it just smells bad. I won't buy this again but I'm likely going to reuse the container

The first jar I bought was great. Effectively removes makeup, hydrates and washes off without a residue. The second jar however was terrible. Removes makeup ok but I still have mascara undermy eyes when I wake yo in the morning, which didnt happen with the first jar. It also left a residue on my skin after rinsing well. And when looking at the balm it appears to have separated layers. The top layer being much more yellow and the bottom more pale. Its like its a completely different product from the first jar I bought. Definitely some quality control issues.

avis.titre: Wonderful for people with sensitive eyes/skin
avis.texte: So many products for the face aggravate my very sensitive eyes (triggering redness, headaches and more). This is one of only a handful of products that I can still use. Very grateful for the lack of fragrance and for its gentle effectiveness

I used to use micellar water in the blue container and it was too oily for my skin so I tried this product snd fell in love!! It is so smooth and removes my makeup with ease! I have very sensitive skin and this didn't irradiate it at all! I definitely recommend this product!
My daughter loves this products. It makes her night routine easy and enjoyable
This product is really good. It melts your makeup off so quick. It's even comes with a spoon which is cute. It don't smell that great. And it's a little on the expensive side.
Best cleanser ever! I have totally switched my cleaners out for this one! It works phenomenally
I've been using this stuff for years, it's the only makeup remover that gets my waterproof mascara off!

I recently bought cause it sounds really good but NO. It doesn't remove make up at all, it's not a good cleanser. It doesn't wash off. The balm remains greasy on the skin and doesn't wash off and therefore the foundation you wear doesn't wash off.
The only cleansing balm I use. I love that Drunk Elephant doesn't add scents to their products. Slaai has a great texture and is effective at removing any makeup.

This isn't like any other cleansing balm I've used. I was really excited when it arrived to give it a try. When I opened it I was a little disappointed because it has a strong unpleasant scent. Who wants to rub something that smells bad on their face? Not me! I scooped a nickel sized blob into my hands and began to warm it between my hands. It does have a very nice texture and it does remove makeup and sunscreen, but it does take a good second cleanser to remove the residue after you wipe it off with a soft cloth. Adding warm water to this thicker than Vaseline cleansing balm does not even begin to remove it. The best way is like I said after massaging it into your skin you need to wipe it off with facial tissue or a soft cloth and then rinse with warm water and wash with a nice cleanser.
Love the feel of this cleanser, it's silky, hydrating and smooth and gets the job done.

avis.titre: The Greatest Thing That Ever Was!!
avis.texte: When I bought this, I saw the word 'cleansing' balm on the label, but I didn't realize it was an actual face cleanser, not just a make-up remover! It works SO well, and I don't have to do two things at night when taking my make-up off (make-up remover then cleanse)! Plus, no more oily eyes! It's so easy to use and gentle on the skin! I am in love with this stuff!

This is my holy grail of face washes!! It takes off a full face of makeup with such ease! And the extra little vial of the exfoliant is greatly used as well! I have sensitive and dry so I have to choose my facial products wisely. I don't have to worry about either with this face wash! It leaves my face feeling clean, refreshed, and just plain good!

I am on the hunt to find a new makeup cleanser after finding out the brand I use is not cruelty free, so I decided to try Drunk Elephants Makeup Melting Butter Cleanser. I really like this product because it has a very gentle formula, hasn't irritated my skin, and smells like bananas (at least I think it does). I have acne prone oily skin so finding products that work for my skin is hard, and Drunk Elephants Cleanser hasn't broken me out so I am thrilled about that. I had to rate it 4 stars instead of 5 because it doesn't completely take off all the makeup unless you scrub your face for 5 minutes or more. Nonetheless I am very satisfied because it compares fairly similar to the brand I used to use. I will keep purchasing!

I first bought this product when I researched ways of traveling with cleansing oil safely. I have never regretted my purchase. I believe I am on my fourth order. The product liquefies easily, but retains a richness. You need very little of the product to cleanse the entire face and neck. The smell is sweet but not sickeningly so. Convenience, effectiveness, economy of this product make me purchasing it repeatedly.

avis.titre: Works well with my acne-prone skin
avis.texte: A gold standard for balm cleansers, I only wish there was less packaging or it was refillable!

When I'm looking for something quick to get my makeup off this is definitely the first thing I grab. It melts your makeup off so fast. It doesn't make your skin feel too oily afterwards. I always use the butter cleanser and a foaming cleanser after. It definitely gets every last bit of makeup off. Such a good product!

avis.titre: Nice but only washes face and nothing special.
avis.texte: I would like to say i bought this so that i could not need to use a water based cleanser but uou still use water for this gel so yeah.

I only use balms to double cleanse/ take my makeup off, so I have tried at least 10 other cleansing balms at this point. This is the only one I have tried that goes on like butter, doesn't smell horrid, takes off all my makeup and mascara, and doesn't burn my eyes or make my eyes blurry. It also has an excellent score on the Yuka app if you care about using non-toxic products. 10/10!
I love cleansing balms and I love this so much and I recommend it to everyone and they love it so much I love it too and it smells so good and I love the color

At first, I was doubting buying this product because of the comments. But I bought it like 3 days ago and i'm in love. This was the first ever balm that I bought. its very good to take off makeup, and double cleaning in general. I added this to my pm routine and my skin is left with a soft finish. My skin is oily and this worked great for me.
I love it melts off my make up like butter. If we try it worth it you should most definitely try it and it comes with a little spoon. It's adorable and there's enough for a pretty long time for me.

I've only had the opportunity to use my sisters melting butter that she had and the times that I have used it I really enjoyed it. This takes off even the most stubborn of make up and leaves your skin feeling pretty fresh and fairly clean. ￼

Let me start out by saying that I have very very few "holy grail" products due to having very sensitive skin. but this product?!?! O. M. G. Takes off my waterproof makeup in an instant. The consistency is wax-like and activated with water. I follow up with a gentle facewash and my skin feels great and not a speck of makeup is leftover. My days of scrubbing with cotton pads with liquid makeup remover or makeup wipes are over. If you love yourself, invest in this product. Also to note, the tub is rather large and will likely last me for months. I wear makeup 5 days out of the week.

This is very effective at removing makeup and sunscreen. It does have an oily feel initially so you'd have to get past the heavy oily feeling but once you mix some water, it turns into a milk consistency. It also washes away fairly clean. I'm not impressed with the mini beads. It's my only reason for dropping the stars.

avis.titre: Drunk elephant!! I love drunk elephant so much!
avis.texte: I live this product! I used it before but I don't have it but it is good! I love All all all all drunk elephant products! I live for drunk elephant so much!

This product is amazing. It takes away all my acne and makes my face feel so smooth after I'm done taking off my make up I love this product I would look into buying it you guys and I have like 20 of these. ￼
I really enjoyed this cleanser as it removed my makeup as well as felt really creamy on my skin. It didn't feel oily and was easy to clean off. It didn't leave my skin feeling stripped either

This is the best make up remover face melting butter- it does melt love it has a little scoop and as it melts on ur face it melts off the makeup then u add a little water to ur face it turns into a milky white color and it's really cleaning !! Love it and for the price it lasts me a while a little goes a long way

avis.titre: I never got the exfoliant beads
avis.texte: I stopped using it because I just felt like I was greasing my face. When I came back to purchase something else I realized I never received the exfoliant beads that go with it. Very disappointed that I have to purchase another just to get the beads so I can get full use of the product.

Just putting this on your face for a second what is change your life? Hi I'm ✨Lindsay✨ and today I'm gonna tell you this magical drunk elephant make up melting butter. It's literally life change by this is all I have to say I am 20 years old and just having one bit at like one, will take off your make up highly recommend

This used to be my favorite cleanser and the only thing to get my make up off. Just got a new jar and they must've changed the formula. It now leaves a terrible oily residue that I have to use my nails to scrape off my face and eyebrows, and doesn't even get all my eye make up off anymore. So sad and disappointed!

This used to be my favorite cleanser and the only thing that got my make up off. I recently got a new jar and they must've changed the formula because it's terrible. It leaves an oily residue that coats my face. I have to use mt nails to literally scrape it off my face. Doesn't even take off all my mascara like it used to. So disappointed!

I bought this a year ago. I am allergic to EVERYTHING and I have the MOST sensitive skin. This leaves my face clean without drying out my skin. I exfoliate every week to get glowing skin. It is truly a 2 in 1 miracle. I am a lifer!

This was the first Drunk Elephant product I've ever tried and I am impressed. Its really satisfying how it removes all your face makeup and you can see the different after applying the water. It didnt remove my mascara but im okay with that. I havent used it long so im interested to see long term affects. Makes my skin soft after removing

Within a week of buying this the product started growing BLACK MOLD. All over the surface and even started spreading onto the lid of the container. Absolutely disgusting. Don't waste your money. Never buying from Drunk Elephant again.

This product is not that good. A family member bought it for me and I tried it once when I put makeup on to try to remove it, and worked but my eyes were all watery which is because of the marula oil. And a week later I found out that I'm allergic to marula oil, which is in this product, and also in every Drunk Elephant product. Why do you have to put marula oil in this product? And also about the Bamboo Booster exfoliant. I was about to use it I found out it contained glycolic acid, something that peels your skin off, and no one wants that. So both of those Drunk Elephant products got taken away because of the the marula oil and how the Bamboo Booster exfoliant has glycolic acid and along with a few others. i won't get this again or any more Drunk Elephant products. Make a version of this without any marula oil.

avis.titre: Wanted to love it, but it stings my eyes.
avis.texte: The great thing I like about this product is the exfoliating beads they have with it, it feels so nice on my skin. The bad thing about this product is that it stings my eyes, and feels very heavy while im trying to rinse it off my skin. After i take it off my skin feels nice though. This product is overall not worth the price point
it removes makeup well and my face looks fresh and clean after using but it stings my eyes and the smell is unpleasant

I love to use Slaai balm before my shower. It's so good for cleaning my pores without drying or stressing out my skin! For comparison, it's thicker and richer than Farmacy's green clean and denser than the Elemis balm.

I really like this cleanser. It does a great job getting makeup off & exfoliating when needed. The spatula that comes with it is great so you don't have to dig your finger in the cleanser. You only need a little bit. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated & clean. The tub lasts a long time. I really like it, but have found similar makeup melting cleansers that do the same and cost less which is why I only gave it 4 stars.

avis.titre: The perfect start to your double cleanse
avis.texte: I was apprehensive about double cleanising but has a sample of this product and tried to give it a shot. Wow. I wake up feeling like my face is made of butter. I have dry skin with some texture and this was a great way to kick off the routine. It definitely seems to make a difference for how well my active ingredient skin care sinks in after using it.

I love cleansing balms. I love that they take off all my heavy makeup without having to scrub my skin. This cleansing balm from Drunk Elephant has so many clean, good for your skin ingredients: 🍃 Soothing Fruit Extracts-Blueberry, Kiwi, Strawberry. 🍃 Replenishing Fruit Oils-Cranberry Seed, Açaí Fruit, Watermelon Seed. To comfort and moisturize. 🍃 Nourishing Oil Blend of-Marula Seed, Baobab Seed, Kalahari Melon Seed, Mongongo, Ximenia. Also comes with 🍃 Bamboo Charcoal Powder-To gently exfoliate away dead skin. I love that Drunk Elephant is a clean company and their ingredients are good for my skin. Also they are vegan and that means a lot. This cleansing balm is so good at removing my heavy makeup but also is gentle on my sensitive skin. The texture is creamy and buttery but once rubbed between your hands melt into a honey like consistency that gently cleans away impurities, makeup, dirt and oil leaving my skin soft and clean. Even removes my waterproof gel liner with no problems. It rinses away clean, with no residue, leaving my skin buttery soft. The difference in the smoothness of my skin after using this is remarkable. So much more softer than using a water based cleanser. I've been using a cleaning balm for a while now, so much easier to remove my makeup, clean my skin and leave behind a soft, smooth surface. You get quite a lot of product for $36 dollars. I like this balm, I like the clean quality ingredients and the after effect it has on my skin. I will definitely
This product really gets all my eye makeup off with minimal scrubbing!

This is one if my favorite products and I have been using for years, honestly almost cried at the new packaging which is hard to get to in the shower. Was hopeful I could just swap the kids from the old and they don't even fit. Ugh I would happily pay extra for the magnet spoon

This is my first cleaning balm I have ever used. Ive had many people recommend to use an oil based cleanser, as I wear both sunscreen & a skin tint. The product works wonderful for my combo skin, and it feels like it does the job. I follow up with the DE jelly cleanser, and my skin is super clean (and not drying) after using both cleansers. I didn't get any pick up on any smells, so this was just fine. There is no fragnance which is great! Highly recommend for those looking for a great staple cleaning balm.

avis.titre: Too oily, hard to get off face, NOT worth the money!
avis.texte: So this I tried to use for a-WHILE because of how much I paid for it, but I just couldn't get into it, and I'm throwing it away only a quarter-way through it. Pros - very moisturizing, does seem to attach to makeup, container is amazing and great amount of product for the price. Cons - SUPER oily, and my skin is dry as heck, expensive (Ponds works just as well), kinda a weird smell, and the worst part... while it does get the makeup off, it's weird, I struggled to get it off my face. Like I would apply it dry and add water, but I had to SCRUB to get it off my face and it made a giant mess in my sink. It's like the oil in it bonds with the oil in makeup and clumps up. I don't know, it's just so weird and hard to get off the face that regardless of whether or worked or not, it just wasn't good to use.

avis.titre: The scent is rough to get past!
avis.texte: Unfortunately the scent is extremely unpleasant and causes me not to want to use the product but once it is on and washed off it worked well.
First time using a balm on my face and I really loved how it felt and cleaned my face

This stuff is amazing. The oil balm really takes off all of my makeup products. Even if it's waterproof. I love using the little powder inside like once a week for a deeper facial scrub. Leaves you very hydrated after using.

avis.titre: Feels so good to clean and moisturize.
avis.texte: My face feels clean and moistured all at the same time. I don't always use the scrubbing powder that comes with it but the combination feels so good. Scrubs of the dead skin and moisturizing all in one.
Any leftover product on my face is even amazed with how well this works! The nice warm consistency is just *chefs kiss* super good for a one cleaning job, but you should double cleanse!
I have been buying this for several years and it takes everything off, including waterproof mascara. It does not irritate my eyes.

Absolutely love this product. I have been searching for a cleanser for years and this is by far the best product I have ever use. My 9 year old daughter has sensitive skin and we use this in her skin and both of us having glowing skin now!

I I love this cleaning balm! I have tried a couple others and this is the one I keep going back to. The price isn't terrible, but it is a bit pricy compared to other options. I like how it doesn't leave a film.
This feels good on the face but the smell is really hard to tolerate.
This product melts away all my make up including mascara! I tend to go darker when I use eyeshadows and I use pigmented eyeshadow. It literally removes it all and makes the process so much easier!!!!

avis.titre: Love the product,hate the new jar lid.
avis.texte: I love the way this works. Cleans off all the makeup easily and leaves my skin soft not dry and tight. I don't like the new top. I preferred the lid with the magnet for the spatula. I tried to fit my old lid and spatula onto the new jar but found the size of the jar is different as well. I will keep using it as I love it but I do wish you would bring back the old packaging. If it aint broke don't fix it!

It feels weird smeary jelly on your face but trust me this works! Easily removes waterproof makeup including stubborn mascara. Leaves skin feeling hydrated and clean. Great for a first step in a double cleanse.
This is great for dry and sensitive skin. It doesn't burn when washing makeup off around my eyes.

I have oily skin and oilies kept raving about cleansing balms. I decided to give it a go and my skin hated it. My derm also said that balms can clog your pores. It made my skin buttery though especially since I use retinoids which makes my skin feel super dry and patchy but I had tons of whiteheads every day.
I usually don't do reviews but this is literally the best product & took my makeup off like magic. highly recommend love love love it
Such a great makeup to remove makeup and excess oil, I use every night!
The application is easy, the product is perfect for double cleansing AND it's cute. Cannot live w out this product, I suggest it to everyone as an Ulta employee
Love using this in the evening to remove makeup. My skin feels so hydrated after using this cleanser.

avis.titre: if ur thinking about buying this, do it!
avis.texte: when i first got it, i was unsure if it would make me break out because i have really sensitive and dry skin. (the smells a little weird but its fine to me) but as soon as i used it my skin hasnt felt better. i dont wear a lot of makeup face but i do wear eyeshadow, eyeliner, and water proof mascara and it melted it off like a dream and didn't dry out my skin! totally recommend if u wear a lot of eye makeup thats hard to get off
it does seem to work well to get the makeup loosened up on my skin, but I have a really hard time removing mascara when I try to use this.

This is a good makeup removers for sensitive skin, gets it all my make up off without feeling dry but god it's smells so bad i gag. I really wanted to love but the smell i literally can't. I will be using clinique

avis.titre: Great for removing makeup, but left with breakouts.
avis.texte: I've been using this product for about 6 weeks now and am looking for something different. I've never had as many blackheads on my nose and have been getting more pimples on my face in general and neck since I've started using this product. It's so easy to remove makeup with this, but not sure if it's worth it for the other problems it's causing.

Nothing else gets mascara off like this stuff. Face makeup has never been an issue for me, my cleanser can do the trick but finding something to get mascara off is so much more difficult. I picked this back up after not trying it in awhile and dont know why i ever set it down. Now its oily, and gets messy, but dedicate a washcloth to it and you wont turn back!

I love DE, except this product. It leaves a layer of waxy oil I have a hard time getting off. It must clog my pores because every time I use, I break out. Didn't even finish it, went back to Clinique take the day off which is more effective, gentle, not waxy and comes off without leaving residue.

avis.titre: Will never use another makeup remover
avis.texte: I don't wear makeup often but when I do I love how easily this product removes it. My face feels clean after with no residue. It's gentle and moisturizing. Products I've used in the past make my face feel tight, dry, and red. I highly recommend.
Don't sleep on this! Truly melts makeup & moisturizes. This is my new favorite face wash. The bamboo booster is awesome too!
Removes all makeup… Even hard to remove mascaras! Also leaves skin glowing!

I've tried quite a few cleansing balms. This is my favorite right now! It has a nice pleasant smell and a little goes a long way! Also, if you need some exfoliation this comes with an exfoliant that you can pour into your hand along with the balm! My skin feels so fantastic after I use it! Love this!

I've never had a makeup remover remove my WATERPROOF makeup so easily and so efficiently. It takes me 30 seconds of rubbing my face with this product and not only is all of my makeup removed, but my skin feels smoother and moisturized. I will never stop buying this!

avis.titre: Just what I was looking for from a make up remover
avis.texte: Gentle on skin, powerful make-up remover. Really rub it in before adding water to get full benefit. My skin feels great after using, feels especially good after adding the exfoliator beads and reapplying the morning after. I usually do this morning treatment after a few days in a row of wearing make-up (Sunday morning routine). I love the little spoon, keeps germs and makeup out of the pot

I love this brand! This product just didn't work for me. I didn't think this broke down the makeup that I had in, and it didn't have a milky texture when I added water. It also left me with a thick oily film on my face even after trying to wash it off with water. I'm not sure if it's just the batch I had, but unfortunately I won't repurchase this product. But I still love other products from this brand

avis.titre: Please go back to original packaging
avis.texte: I fell in love with this cleaner. there are a lot of balms out there but this was so easy to apply because of the jar. The price makes it is a luxury, but really a deal because it lasts so long. I recommended to everyone..... then I bought again at Sephora and found the packaging had changed. Not good. this notch clasp thing, not the same. the magnet was brilliant! I would rather use my fingers than fumble through fitting that spatula back on the lid. I hate to sound petty but it really is these small differences that matter. In addition, and I hope Im wrong, but he formula was changed? it does not wash off as easily. It is more waxy and I need a cloth to help wash off. before, water was enough. Please go back to your roots. I can buy Clinique 'wash the day off´ if I want a sticky balm. Thank you for considering my feedback.
This melting butter takes off my makeup, like butter. While it is oily, it doesn't leave your skin that way once you wash your face.
My make-up melting butter cleanser is one of my all-time fave products to use. A little goes such a long way, and doesn't damage or dry out my skin at all. Thank you so much for this amazing product!

This product lives on the shelf in my shower! I use it every time I have on makeup in a day as a first step cleanser. This thick but easily spreadable consistency truly takes away waterproof makeup and more. I first massage my face and often add the exfoliate that comes with it. Then I set my hands and massages the balm cleanser even more. I love this stuff with or without makeup- but with makeup makes this a must use to really cleanse at the end of an old day so a new day and new fresh face takes over!

avis.titre: Disappointed in this purchase of cleanser.
avis.texte: Product was old and cracking, dark yellow, smelled like wax. Not anything like it used to be.
